channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Sharjah Airport: How to Quickly Rent a Car and Return It
item.description: Timing is everything at Sharjah Airport. When the flights stack up, the rental lines follow suit.

item.title: Smart Strategies to Cut Moving Costs Without Sacrificing Quality
item.description: Relocating to a new home is an exciting milestone, but it often comes with a hefty price tag.

item.title: What to Know Before Moving In or Out of an HOA in Woodbridge
item.description: Homeowners associations (HOAs) can offer well-maintained environments and valuable amenities, but they also come with rules, especially when it comes to moving.

item.title: How to Pack Fragile Items for a Move Without Breaking Them
item.description: Packing can be stressful, but when it comes to fragile items, the stakes are even higher.

item.title: Downsizing to a Desert Oasis: Embracing Minimalism in Las Vegas
item.description: The decision to downsize rarely comes easy.

item.title: Is Phoenix A Good Place To Live For Families, Singles, And Retirees?
item.description: Phoenix is a dynamic city offering strong options for families (especially those with school-aged kids), career-focused singles, and retirees seeking warm weather.

item.title: Revitalized Pheasants Forever chapter holds first meeting in Mower County
item.description: After a lull, Mower County's Pheasants Forever chapter has reorganized under new leader Briana Whittington, aiming to boost habitat, public access and draw the next generation of upland hunters.

item.title: Different backgrounds, same goals: A pair of of Packer freshman wrestlers have taken different paths to success
item.description: Austin freshmen Jaydn Xiquita and Jaxon Learn, from contrasting wrestling backgrounds, become the Packers’ first ninth-grade state qualifiers since 2019.

item.title: Minn. companies pool funds to help small businesses amidst immigration enforcement surge
item.description: Nearly 30 Minnesota companies, including Target and General Mills, are pooling $4M in a Minneapolis Foundation fund to help small businesses hit by stepped-up immigration enforcement.

item.title: Taylor Rogers wasn’t Twins’ last addition to bullpen
item.description: Despite reuniting with Taylor Rogers and making other moves, the Twins say they still plan to add bullpen help via trades, free agents and potential starter-to-reliever shifts.
